limitations: Separate campaigns, not randomized paired power-mode trials.
Before/after observations do not prove continuous power or thermal stability.
Battery percentage is a coarse condition check, not an energy-efficiency measurement.
Historical AC reports use a different revision and are context, not controlled samples.
AC observations showed active charging (47% to 59%); charge and charging state were not matched across conditions.
Normal battery observations stayed at 99%; the operator confirmed unplugged operation with Low Power Mode off throughout. This does not quantify energy use.
Thermal telemetry was unavailable at all 144 sample boundaries; throttling and thermal equivalence were not established.
The suggested pre-campaign idle cooldown and background-app setup are operator procedures, not verified by the recorded evidence.

publication.title: CPU scaling across AC, battery, and Low Power Mode
publication.audit_scope: Recomputed comparison plus independent log/history, accounting, cooldown, deadline, and cleanup audit. WAL files were retained and hashed, not independently replayed in this review.

operator_confirmation.source: User confirmation in the benchmark review conversation
operator_confirmation.statement: Yes, unplugged throughout; Low Power Mode stayed off
operator_confirmation.observation_note: Recorded boundary readings remained at 99%. This confirmation does not establish energy consumption or continuous instrumented power monitoring.

publication.raw_evidence: Git-ignored .benchmark-evidence/power-scaling-20261014.tar.gz; available locally, not included in the source repository
